readability.rationale: Small files with one job each: db schema, html escaping, page shell, app factory, server entry.

maintainability.rationale: createApp(db) takes the database as input, so tests and the server share one composition path; no speculative layers.

security.rationale: Server binds to 127.0.0.1 only; html tagged template escapes every interpolated value by default; x-powered-by disabled.

reliability.rationale: Schema uses CHECK constraints for status and date order, foreign keys on, WAL and busy_timeout for concurrent access; schema creation is idempotent and verified by the smoke test.

scalability.rationale: Index on reservation(equipment_id, status, start_date, end_date) supports the overlap lookup; local single-file SQLite fits the local single-machine scope.

compatibility.rationale: Requires Node 24 type stripping; engines field declares it; tsconfig enforces erasable syntax so Node can run the sources directly.

findings.summary: views.ts referenced a non-existent SafeHtmlStyle class.

tradeoffs: Server-rendered pages without client JavaScript (ADR-02). The E2E database is a fresh temp file per run.
